# directus_collection (Resource)

A collection: a database table, or (with `table = false`) a group that only organises other collections in the data model. Destroying a table collection drops the table and every row in it, so it is guarded by `allow_destroy`. See the [Directus collections API](https://directus.io/docs/api/collections).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group: organises collections in the data model, has no table.
resource "directus_collection" "content" {
  collection = "content"
  table      = false
  icon       = "folder"
}

resource "directus_collection" "articles" {
  collection  = "articles"
  primary_key = { type = "uuid" }
  group       = directus_collection.content.collection
  icon        = "article"
  translations = jsonencode([
    { language = "en-US", translation = "Articles", singular = "Article", plural = "Articles" },
  ])

  # Destroying a table collection drops the table and every row. Leave this
  # false; set it to true and apply only when you really mean to drop it.
  allow_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection` (String) Collection name: the table name for a table collection. Changing it replaces the collection.

### Optional

- `accountability` (String) What Directus tracks for this collection: `all` (activity and revisions, the default) or `activity`.
- `allow_destroy` (Boolean) Allow Terraform to destroy this collection (for a table: its table and every row), including replacing it. Defaults to `false`: a plan that would destroy or replace it fails. Set `allow_destroy = true` and apply that first, then remove or replace the resource. Like `lifecycle.prevent_destroy`, but enforced by the provider and off by default.
- `archive_app_filter` (Boolean) Hide archived items in the Data Studio by default. Defaults to `true`.
- `archive_field` (String) Field that holds the archive status.
- `archive_value` (String) Value of `archive_field` that marks an item archived.
- `autosave_revision_interval` (Number) Autosave interval for revisions, in seconds.
- `collapse` (String) For a group: `open` (default), `closed`, or `locked`.
- `color` (String) Hex colour of the collection's icon.
- `display_template` (String) Template used to display an item of this collection, e.g. `{{title}}`.
- `group` (String) Name of the parent group collection.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Hide the collection from the Data Studio navigation. Defaults to `false`.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name shown for the collection.
- `item_duplication_fields` (List of String) Fields copied when an item is duplicated in the Data Studio.
- `note` (String) Help text shown under the collection name.
- `preview_url` (String) URL template for the live-preview pane.
- `primary_key` (Attributes) The primary-key field, created with the table and owned by this resource (do not also declare it as a `directus_field`). Omit it for an auto-increment integer `id`. Not allowed on a group. Changing it replaces the collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--primary_key))
- `singleton` (Boolean) Treat the collection as a single item. Defaults to `false`.
- `sort` (Number) Position of the collection in the navigation, within its group.
- `sort_field` (String) Field used for manual drag-and-drop sorting.
- `table` (Boolean) `true` (default) for a table collection; `false` for a group with no table. Directus cannot convert one into the other, so changing it replaces the collection.
- `translations` (String) Collection-name translations, as JSON: `jsonencode([{ language = "en-US", translation = "Articles", singular = "Article", plural = "Articles" }])`.
- `unarchive_value` (String) Value `archive_field` is set to when an item is unarchived.
- `versioning` (Boolean) Enable content versioning. Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--primary_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `primary_key`

Required:

- `type` (String) `integer` or `bigInteger` (auto-increment), `uuid` (generated by Directus), or `string` (set by the client).

Optional:

- `field` (String) Field name. Defaults to `id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import directus_collection.articles articles
```
